name: BRAND TEXT
description:
At Aqua-Coast Engineering we provide building-envelope consulting & inspection solutions to the New Construction & Restoration Industry. We offer:



New Construction Building Envelope Consulting & Inspection services. Building Envelope Assessment, Consulting & Restoration Project Management. Roof Assessment, Consulting & Inspections. Depreciation Reports, Annual Inspections and Maintenance Manuals.



Aqua-Coast consists of an experienced team of Engineers, Project Managers & Consultants. We provide progressive, sustainable, and cost-efficient engineering services to clients in The Lower Mainland, Vancouver Island, Interior British Columbia & Western Canada.<
